licenseEvidence.name: Paizo OGL/Product Identity and Open Content declaration
licenseEvidence.scope: The published declaration states that game mechanics are Open Game Content except material designated Product Identity. Each included book title is also checked against the embedded Section 15 text.

licenseEvidence.name: Embedded Open Game License and Section 15
licenseEvidence.scope: The full OGL 1.0a and Section 15 notice text are copied into every generated asset; the OGL declaration is embedded separately.

licenseEvidence.name: Mythic Adventures Section 15 notice
licenseEvidence.scope: Mythic Adventures is listed in the embedded Section 15 notice; its indexed game mechanics, stat blocks, and item-table facts are selected subject to record-level exclusions.

licenseEvidence.name: PSRD-Data book-ogl.db license records
licenseEvidence.scope: The database's Community Use License rows are excluded. All Tome of Horrors named attributions are checked by exact item name; matching records are excluded before package generation.

included: Indexed game mechanics, afflictions, creature statistics, and item-table facts from snapshot books whose exact titles appear in the embedded Section 15 notice.

All indexed ability records in verified Section 15 books are reviewed; distinct same-name rules are retained, while exact duplicate text, empty/corrupted records, known PI markers, and exact third-party attributions are held with record-level reasons.
Creature packages contain structured game statistics only, without artwork or narrative flavor prose.
Item descriptions are generated from structured table facts; source item prose is not copied.
Conditions are categorized separately from effects when their names overlap; identical duplicate records are represented once.
excluded: Records from sources not named in the embedded Section 15 notice, including Technology Guide.
Records whose names match individual third-party attributions in book-ogl.db.
Known PI-related names and records from artifact sections are held for individual review; a hold is not a conclusion that every artifact or name is PI.
Records with missing names or structured data, corrupted/empty source text, and exact duplicate data are held with record-level reasons.

coverage.status: Selection inventory is fully counted. Excluded/pending records are not claimed to be non-redistributable and require individual rights/content review.
